title: Warm Smoky Polish Shrimp Skewers
description: A low-fat Polish dish featuring shrimp skewers with a smoky flavor, served in agave leaves and infused with Grand Marnier, perfect for a dinner meal.
instructions: Preheat grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together Grand Marnier, smoked paprika, lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Add the shrimp to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread 4-6 shrimp onto each agave leaf, leaving a small space between each shrimp.
Place the agave leaves on the grill and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until the shrimp are pink and cooked through.
Serve the shrimp skewers warm, garnished with additional smoked paprika if desired.
Discard the agave leaves before serving, as they are not edible.
